purpose: Reconcile the online Infinity 2D20 character sheet with the Haqqislam Supplement supplied in the user's Google Drive source folder.
sourceBackedChanges: Replaces placeholder Haqq faction choices with Haqqislam, Sword of Allah, Qapu Khalqi, Hassassin Bahram, and Guilds.
Adds 17 Bourak / Haqqislam Homeworld or Habitat choices and explicit Faction relationships.

Adds the Haqq Faction Social Status Table, Al-Mustaslaha table/rules, Adolescent Event Table, Expanded Faction Career Table, and Hassassin Orders Table to source-reference data and the browser glossary.
Adds 16 new Haqq source career profiles; the already-existing Special Forces profile is cross-referenced to the Haqq supplement.
Adds source attribute modifiers, mandatory/elective skills, earnings, career gear and special restrictions to Career glossary entries.
Adds 60 Haqq source gear records, including 6 weapons, augmentations, programs, drugs, poisons, tools, armour variants, remotes and vehicle reference profiles.
Adds missing Haqq adolescent-event Trait names without overwriting existing same-name generic Traits.
Adds source/page metadata to Haqq faction, homeworld, career, Trait and gear reference content.
Adds migration from legacy Akbar/Ghulam/Fiday/Janissary/Khawarij/Scholar-Physician placeholder factions to source-backed faction choices.
Migrates the legacy 360* Visor spelling to 360° Visor.
Prevents location-based source armour such as Ad-Qali and Khafiin from being silently converted to the custom 5/10/15 Armour track; the sheet shows a manual-source-profile notice instead.
preservedCustomContent: Existing custom Haqq talent chains are retained for compatibility but are not falsely source-tagged as Haqqislam Supplement content.
Existing custom Career filtering, main-skill/Focus house rules, Dogface automation, browser saves, XML import/export, print portfolio, 5 Weapon slots and 10 Equipment slots remain intact.
sourceNormalisation: Persuasion is normalised to the sheet skill name Persuade.
Ballistic in the Kum Ganger and Muhafiz Agent source profiles is normalised to Ballistics.
The Khawarij mandatory line Athletics / Discipline / Athletics is preserved exactly rather than silently guessing a replacement skill.
Boarding-Colt follows the narrative/index spelling; the source table rendering contains Boading-Col.
Rihla Rations follows the gear catalogue spelling; one career line prints Riha Rations.
